Navidrome Audiophile Music Cloud & Streamer

Personal high-resolution music cloud with full Subsonic & OpenSubsonic API

● Web UI Port 4533 / Subsonic API Ready

🎧 Native Client Applications (Desktop & Mobile)

Connect any Subsonic-compatible player to your server using http://pineapple-server:4533:

Feishin (Desktop) ↗ Modern, high-performance desktop music player for Linux, macOS & Windows
Symfonium (Android) ↗ Audiophile Android music player with offline caching, equalizer & Android Auto
Substreamer (iOS) ↗ Smooth mobile player for iPhone with gapless playback & CarPlay support
Navidrome Web UI ↗ Browser interface accessible instantly without installing anything

📁 Music Directory & File Organization

Your music files live in /srv/media/music. Navidrome reads FLAC, MP3, AAC, ALAC, Opus, and Ogg Vorbis with ID3 embedded artwork and lyrics.
